description: Semantic concept-to-feature mappings for the Massaciuccoli Digital Twin data task. Benchmark resolutions and specialist groups are query-resolution mappings, not causal claims or a literal reconstruction of any paper classification.

feature_catalog.change_in_tree_cover_density_past_decade: Change in tree cover density in past decade
feature_catalog.index_of_total_productivity_by_plant_phe: Index of total productivity by plant phenology
feature_catalog.number_of_species_potentially_living_in_: Number of species potentially living in the cell
feature_catalog.change_in_land_use_and_cover: Change in land use and cover

groups.label: Climate and environmental stress
groups.description: Climate-related indicators represented in the dataset.
groups.limitations: These proxies do not directly measure water availability, drought severity, lake water level, or the full hydrological regime.

groups.label: Ecological fragility
groups.description: Cross-cutting proxies for aspects of ecological fragility or vulnerability.
groups.limitations: Fragility is not directly measured; these are contextual proxies and do not establish a universal direction or fragility score.

groups.label: Biodiversity and species richness
groups.description: Potential number of species living in a grid cell.
groups.limitations: Represents potential species richness, not abundance, composition, genetic diversity, or complete biodiversity.

groups.label: Forest and tree cover
groups.description: Tree-cover structure and its change over the past decade.

groups.label: Grassland and meadow habitat
groups.description: Grassland presence and changes in grassland presence.

groups.label: Vegetation and vegetation dynamics
groups.description: Structural and functional vegetation indicators represented by the simulator.

groups.label: Ecosystem functioning
groups.description: Vegetation, habitat structure, productivity, and potential species-richness proxies relevant to ecosystem functioning.
groups.limitations: The dataset represents selected components and proxies; it does not measure ecosystem functioning comprehensively.

groups.label: Anthropogenic and human pressures
groups.description: Land-use-related indicators and imperviousness change as proxies for human pressure.
groups.limitations: Does not directly represent pollution, pesticides, fertilizers, traffic, connectivity, or pressure types absent from the dataset.

groups.label: Land use, land cover and landscape composition
groups.description: Land-use/cover indicators and imperviousness change as a complementary landscape indicator.

groups.label: Habitat degradation and alteration
groups.description: Structural, land-use and functional proxies relevant to habitat condition and alteration.
groups.limitations: Habitat quality/degradation is not directly measured as a single feature; this combines related indicators.

groups.label: All ecological and environmental assessment variables
groups.description: Canonical full-dataset feature mapping, also used for broad ecological-variable and ecosystem-assessment requests.
groups.limitations: This mapping returns all 12 simulator features; it is not a claim that every feature directly measures ecological risk or ecosystem condition.

groups.label: Environmental stressors
groups.description: Environmental and anthropogenic pressure indicators selected as environmental stressors.
groups.limitations: Operational semantic grouping; does not directly measure all stressors such as pollution, nutrient loading, water levels, or hydrological stress.

groups.label: Stressful environmental conditions
groups.description: Environmental pressures and environmental/ecological state indicators that can help characterize potentially stressful conditions.
groups.limitations: Variables are relevant to potentially stressful conditions; the group itself does not assert that any feature value is intrinsically harmful.

groups.label: Ecological dynamics
groups.description: Indicators representing changes, evolution, or dynamic processes across ecological and environmental components.
groups.limitations: The grouping includes change indicators and the plant productivity/phenology index as a dynamic-process proxy; it is not a uniform time-series dataset.

resolution_notes.multiple_groups: Union matched feature IDs and deduplicate.
resolution_notes.aliases: Resolve semantic aliases to their canonical group ID; do not maintain duplicate feature lists for identical mappings.
resolution_notes.unknown_concept: Do not silently return all features; fallback behavior remains to be defined.
resolution_notes.percent_change_interpretation: For biodiversity/species-richness percentage changes in scenario questions, interpret them as relative changes to the baseline proxy, not absolute values.

ecological_variables.description: Alias to the canonical full 12-feature mapping.

ecosystem_assessment.description: Alias to the canonical full 12-feature mapping.
